hold_text: Lane TRADEIFY-DRY (manager session_01MM8o5js6TcDFeNAPBY4Ntv): code changes go in a HELD Tier-2 PR for the manager. This changes the prop quote read (src/prop/platform/dxtrade.py quote_from_tables), which the executor uses to price brackets for both prop accounts.
